annotations.title: List the changes that reach a workflow

description: Changes whose effects reach a WORKFLOW's steps — or any nested workflow's — plus changes anchored to it with no effects yet, each with what it does per step. Pass their ids to compass_workflow_rollup's changeIds to project the workflow after them.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.
